# Matter Poise
Robotics & Intelligent Machines. Matter, poised to act.

## Company website
- [Company](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/about/): company purpose and team experience.
- [Products](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/products/): GROUNDWISE quadruped systems, WAYROUND spherical systems, FlatHill dexterous manipulation end-effectors.
- [ROSE](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/rose/): proprietary AI-assisted engineering system in development.
- [Engineering & Integration](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/engineering/): engineering, buildability, testing, serviceability and repeatability.

## Public technical references
- [Model catalog](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/models/): eleven model and platform snapshots.
- [Documentation](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/docs/): handbook, CSVs, integration guide and source register.
- [Structured product data](https://flat-hill.github.io/company/catalog.json): source values, design targets, pending values and conflicts remain distinct.
Detailed CAD, SDK, firmware, test evidence and manufacturing packages require a project-specific team handoff; no authenticated portal is offered here.

## Separate investor materials
- [Investor presentation](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/): independently maintained business presentation.
- [Investor Agent](https://flat-hill.github.io/matter-poise/agent/): dated briefing and portable Skill, not a live team connection.
Company experience, development targets and future plans must not be treated as verified company traction, final specifications or current production capacity.
